current_goals: Solidify addition and subtraction with regrouping
Complete daily plan with less prompting over time

frustration_triggers: being corrected in front of others
tasks with no visible end point

daily_schedule_constraints: Needs warm-up time before academic tasks
routine_profile.energy_patterns: slow-start — needs 10–15 min of low-demand activity before academic work

lessons_that_worked: Short reading passages about dogs or animals
Math problems with real-world contexts (money, measurement)
Drawing as a response or summary activity
lessons_that_failed: Open-ended writing prompts with no structure
engagement_patterns: High engagement when topic involves animals
High engagement when task has a visible finish line
Low engagement when instructions are given verbally only
recent_wins: Completed 5 reading sessions in a row without skipping
Solved regrouping problems independently on 2 consecutive days
Started reading block without prompting on Friday
current_struggle_flags: Often needs multiple prompts to begin math block
Frequently leaves reading tasks 90% done without clicking 'Done'
Transitions from reading to math are bumpy

task_initiation.notes: First-step-only prompts work well. Getting started within 2–3 min on good days.

planning_organization.notes: Benefits from visible step list before starting. Can follow a pre-set plan.

working_memory.notes: Vocabulary anchor cards are essential. Re-asks instructions frequently without them.

transitions.notes: 2-min warning + named transition phrase + movement break = smooth transitions.

sustained_focus.notes: 15-min max blocks. Interest hooks at start of each block help.

task_completion.notes: Done confirmation screens help her register closure. Trend is positive.

emotional_regulation.notes: Gentle error framing is essential. No red X. No 'wrong, try again.'

time_awareness.notes: Responds well to time analogies: 'This is about as long as 2 songs.'

impulse_control.notes: One-task-at-a-time view reduces jumping ahead. Single visible step helps.
